issues.where: When Rudra, the bull, begot you
issues.problem: gram says ajani is 3 sg. aor. PASSIVE ('was born'), the gloss says 'was born, begot', and vaḥ is glossed acc. pl. ('you'); a passive cannot take 'you' as object. The translation (and Hindi) picks the active 'begot', which the notes admit is 'taken from the sense of the line'.
issues.fix: Make gram, gloss, vo and both translations agree: either passive ('when Rudra, the bull, was born / begotten for you, O Maruts ... in the bright udder of Pṛśni' with vaḥ dat./gen.) or defend 'begot' in notes; no patch because it is a decision.

summary: Reviewed 15 units of RV 2.34. Total issues: 3 error, 20 minor. Errors: unit 2 ajani is labelled aor. passive but the translations have the active 'begot' with 'you' as object; unit 5 Hindi contains the stray remark 'कुछ अनिश्चित अर्थ वाले' inside the translation; unit 9 vadhaḥ labelled inst. pl. (impossible form), so 'with weapons' is unsupported. Minor: fixed-rendering deviations (brahman/dhī/vājin/ṛta in Hindi or English, units 6, 7, 13), iṣ Hindi 'अन्न' vs 'refreshment', bhuvana 'beings' vs 'world', additions in Hindi/English ('उसकी', 'किरणों', 'their'), small gram points (duhuḥ, nide, mahaḥ), unit 8 ā translated in Hindi only. Units 1, 11, 14, 15 are ok. The '१' marks in vya१bhriyā are accent signs and rightly not flagged. Confidences honest. No regrouping suggested.
